profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-based public company, traded as HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. According to its own site, the company makes lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and says its sensors serve as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot). It states that it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle, and robotics companies worldwide and has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries.

The site says Hesai's sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, aimed at robotaxis and robobuses that operate with little to no human input, and that the company also serves trucking, robotics, and industrial applications. It frames its work around improving safety and performance for the automotive industry.

The company's held record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile gives a CIK of 0001861737, confirming registration with the SEC as a for-profit public company.
